leads.title: Council commissions
leads.detail: Rolf says to read the proclamations at City Hall and ask the clerk about commissions.

leads.title: Training in New Phlan
leads.detail: Rolf showed the party where adventurers train. Return to the training schools when a character is ready to advance.

leads.title: The sea lanes
leads.detail: Rolf says few ships risk the passage and the council wants to reopen it.

leads.title: Proclamation LXIV
leads.detail: The party recorded this council proclamation. Its text is in the Adventurer's Journal.

leads.title: Proclamation LXXVIII
leads.detail: The party recorded this council proclamation. Its text is in the Adventurer's Journal.

leads.title: Proclamation CIX
leads.detail: The party recorded this council proclamation. Its text is in the Adventurer's Journal.

leads.title: Proclamation LIX
leads.detail: The party recorded this council proclamation. Its text is in the Adventurer's Journal.

leads.title: Passage to Sokal Keep
leads.detail: The harbor master says you can reach the keep by boat.

leads.title: Arrival at Sokal Keep
leads.detail: The party landed on Thorn Island.

leads.title: Reeds by the keep gate
leads.detail: The party saw a mound of reeds west of the gates.

leads.title: The parchment at Sokal Keep
leads.detail: The party found a damaged scroll on a dead elf outside the keep.

leads.title: Sokal Keep patrol
leads.detail: The undead patrol accepted the word and let the party pass.

leads.title: Ferran Martinez
leads.detail: Ferran is bound to guard the keep and asks whether Phlan has been freed.

leads.title: Sokal courtyard ambush
leads.detail: A large force of orcs and hobgoblins rushed the party through the courtyard door.

leads.title: Note from the courtyard
leads.detail: The party found a note on a fallen hobgoblin and copied it as journal entry 57.

leads.title: Sokal Keep chapel
leads.detail: The party found the remains of two orcs in the doorway and a large altar against the south wall.

leads.title: The keep's pale figure
leads.detail: A pale figure appeared inside the keep. The party can try speaking to it.

leads.title: Ferran's account of Phlan's fall
leads.detail: Ferran said creatures empowered by a magical pool overran Phlan. He named Tyranthraxus, Edranka, and Torath as their leaders.

leads.title: Mendor's lost histories
leads.detail: Ferran says Mendor gathered accounts of the powers that brought down Phlan. His library was overrun.

leads.title: Sokal Keep armory
leads.detail: Ferran says help lies beyond an illusory wall in the armory.

leads.title: Ferran's password
leads.detail: Ferran told the party to say SAMOSUD to his guards on the way out.

leads.title: Journal entry 57
leads.detail: The party encountered a reference to entry 57 in the Adventurer's Journal.

leads.title: Boat back from Thorn Island
leads.detail: The party found a boat returning to New Phlan at the south pier.

leads.title: Clear the Slums - in progress
leads.detail: Keep clearing encounters in the Slums until the district is secure. 1 of 25 encounters cleared.

leads.title: Clear Sokal Keep - turned in
leads.detail: The council acknowledged the result.

leads.title: Recover records of old Phlan - offered
leads.detail: Search the old city for historical records and bring worthwhile finds to the clerk.

leads.title: Investigate the auction - turned in
leads.detail: The council acknowledged the result.

leads.title: The harbor routes are open
leads.detail: The harbor master offers passage east, west, back to Sokal Keep, and to the north side of the bay.

leads.title: Return ferry to New Phlan
leads.detail: Choose Take Boat at the dock to return to the civilized part of Phlan.

leads.title: The crowd at Podal Plaza
leads.detail: The party can disguise itself as monsters or sneak past the crowd.

leads.title: The auction has begun
leads.detail: The auctioneer announced a powerful magical item to the crowd.

leads.title: An approach to the auction
leads.detail: The party chose how to cross the crowd at Podal Plaza.

leads.title: The high bid
leads.detail: A man in plain clothes standing next to an ogre bid 5,000 gold pieces.

leads.title: The auction exchange
leads.detail: The party saw a man and an ogre exchange the wand and a large bag before disappearing into the crowd.

leads.title: Recover Cadorna's treasure - turned in
leads.detail: Cadorna's treasure affair is settled.

leads.title: Textile House courtyard ambush
leads.detail: A drum sounded as hobgoblins attacked the party in the courtyard.

leads.title: Textile House courtyard cleared
leads.detail: The drum fell silent after the party defeated the courtyard hobgoblins.

leads.title: The hobgoblins' chief
leads.detail: The party found the ogre chief in a torchlit room beyond the secret door.

leads.title: Cadorna's sealed iron box
leads.detail: The family seal across the lock will break if the party opens the box.

leads.title: The Watch took Cadorna's treasure
leads.detail: The Watch sent the party to the city clerk to collect its reward.

leads.title: Follow up with the Temple of Tyr - offered
leads.detail: Speak with Bishop Braccio at Tyr's temple about his summons.

leads.title: Thieves in Kovel Mansion
leads.detail: Two thieves fled through the east door after their attack failed.

leads.title: The thieves split up
leads.detail: One ran east and the other ran south.

leads.title: Mansion ambush
leads.detail: Thieves attacked the party inside the mansion.

leads.title: Mansion ambush cleared
leads.detail: The party defeated the thieves who set the ambush.

leads.title: The Nomad Camp
leads.detail: The party found a camp on the overland route and can choose Enter or Leave.

leads.title: The camp is on guard
leads.detail: The nomads held their swords ready and watched the party. More emerged from the tents.

leads.title: The nomads wait
leads.detail: The nomads are watching the party and waiting to see how it approaches them.

leads.title: The headman's invitation
leads.detail: The headman invited the party to a feast in its honor.

leads.title: Honored guests at the Nomad Camp
leads.detail: The party accepted the invitation and the nomads held contests of strength and skill in its honor.

leads.title: Hassad Ahwal's account
leads.detail: The headman described the region's dangers. The party recorded his account as journal entry 55.

leads.title: The headman fears a raid
leads.detail: The headman's scouts found signs of kobolds nearby. He asked the party to stay until they pass.

leads.title: Stay or leave the camp
leads.detail: The headman asked the party for its answer. The choices are Stay and Fight or Leave.

leads.title: The party declined to stay
leads.detail: The headman wished the party well after it chose to leave.

leads.title: The kobold cave fork
leads.detail: The party found a concealed cave beside a larger entrance and can choose which to explore.

leads.title: Envoys at the throne
leads.detail: The party found two envoys at the kobold throne.

leads.title: The king's concealed ballistae
leads.detail: The kobold king ordered his guards to fire concealed ballistae in the throne room.

leads.title: The king escaped
leads.detail: The kobold king slipped away during the fight at the throne.

leads.title: Secret door in the north wall
leads.detail: The party found a hidden door in the kobold caves after the king escaped.

leads.title: The king's quarters
leads.detail: The party reached the king's quarters and encountered his guards.

leads.title: The kobold king fell
leads.detail: The king panicked, fell into his own spiked pit, and died.

leads.title: Out of the kobold caves
leads.detail: The party returned to the overland route after the king fell.

leads.title: Clear Kovel Mansion - turned in
leads.detail: The council acknowledged the result.

leads.title: Stop kobold reinforcements - turned in
leads.detail: The council acknowledged the result.

leads.title: Investigate the nomad camp - turned in
leads.detail: The council acknowledged the result.

leads.title: End the river pollution - ready to report
leads.detail: Report the end of the river pollution to the council clerk in New Phlan.

leads.title: Healing at the Temple of Tyr
leads.detail: The priests at the Temple of Tyr in New Phlan offer healing.

leads.title: Thief training door
leads.detail: Go east past the arena to the north door marked Rogues, next to the fighter school. Accept the trainer's offer, select the thief, then choose Train Character.

leads.title: Fighter training door
leads.detail: Go east past the arena in New Phlan, then take the north door marked Fighters. Accept the trainer's offer and select Train Character.

leads.title: Adventuring partners in New Phlan
leads.detail: The arena master can introduce adventurers who take a share of the party's treasure.

leads.title: Training school directions
leads.detail: From the notices, go north to train magic users or clerics. Go east to train fighters or rogues.

leads.title: Mendor's library stacks
leads.detail: The party found rooms of books marked by subject. Use Search to examine the shelves.

leads.title: Rhetoric stacks
leads.detail: The party read the Rhetoric sign in Mendor's Library. Use Search to examine the shelves in that room.

leads.title: Philosophy stacks
leads.detail: The party read the Philosophy sign in Mendor's Library. Use Search to examine the shelves in that room.

leads.title: Fyerdetha's Discourses on Power
leads.detail: Bring the record copied as journal entry 7 to the council clerk at City Hall.

leads.title: Journal entry 7
leads.detail: The party encountered a reference to entry 7 in the Adventurer's Journal.

leads.title: The library's guardian
leads.detail: A spectre accused the party of taking the library's books and attacked it.

leads.title: A rowboat in the reeds
leads.detail: The party found a hidden boat that can reach the pyramid.

leads.title: The pyramid's secret door
leads.detail: The party found a secret entrance at the front of the pyramid.

leads.title: The fountain chamber
leads.detail: Pipes in the fountain chamber pump foul black water.

leads.title: Prisoners at the pumps
leads.detail: Three shackled lizardfolk were forced to pump and pour the contaminant.

leads.title: The prisoners' advice
leads.detail: The freed prisoners told the party about Yarash and how to ask their tribe in the swamp for help. Read journal entry 35.

leads.title: Journal entry 35
leads.detail: The party encountered a reference to entry 35 in the Adventurer's Journal.

leads.title: The land is recovering
leads.detail: On leaving the pyramid, the party saw the land beginning to recover.

leads.title: The river can recover
leads.detail: The party stopped the pyramid's pollution.

leads.title: The castle drawbridge
leads.detail: An old drawbridge provides a safe crossing into the ruins.

leads.title: Anti-magic in the ruins
leads.detail: The party sensed an anti-magic shell on entering the ruined castle.
